articleTitle: Optical Current Transformer Accuracy Problems and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: Explain the factors which affect the performance of optical current transformer (OCT) and Solutions. Signal processing measure is the key to the application of optical current transformer. Therefore the signal processing system's improved method of optical current transformer was introduced, and prospects the future development of optical current transformers.

articleTitle: Research of Flow Boiling Bubble Dynamics in Vertical Rectangular Mini-channel
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: Flow boiling in vertical rectangular mini-channel with width of 2mm and length of 390mm is studied in this paper. In single-side heating situation, the narrow channel is divided into three zones, bubbles generating zone, growth zone and annihilation zone. The motion characteristics of bubbles in various stages are accompanied by the changes of three zones. The courses of bubbles generation, growth and departure are numerically simulated. All the calculation conducted takes the gravity, surface tension and wall adhesion into account. Found that surface tension is much more important than gravity in the process of boiling heat transfer. As the overheating increases, the departure diameter D of bubbles increases significantly. When the bubble diameter D is larger than 1.5mm, it will be influenced by the incoming flow. The existence of bubble bottom micro-layer accelerates the flow convection on the wall and increases the coefficient of heat transfer. The results of simulation have a good coherence with experimental datum.

articleTitle: Research on Enhancing Human Finger Vein Pattern Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: Finger-vein pattern can be applied to personal identification. But due to many reasons, the captured finger-vein images are blurred and contain a lot of noise. In this paper, we propose a new method to enhance the contrast of the finger-vein image. It consists of three parts: wavelet denoising, contrast enhancement and binary image. At first, we perform stationary wavelet decomposition and transform the image into four frequency bands: low frequency band LL, middle frequency bands LH and HL, and high frequency band HH. To different frequency bands, we design different denoising method. Then we select a special sort of histogram template equalization method to enhance the contrast of the finger-vein image. Finally, we get the binary image using the OTSU method. Our experimental results in this paper show that the proposed method can properly enhance the contrast of the finger-vein image and gets good effect.

articleTitle: Research on Network Virtual Electrical and Electronic Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: The Network Virtual Electrical and Electronic Laboratory makes use of the simulation technology and the virtual reality technology to build a virtual experiment environment on the Internet. The virtual lab can meet the students' requirements of making simulation electronic experiments and achieving interaction with teachers and other school fellows, and help the students with their experiment preparation as well as improve their practical abilities. Network Virtual Laboratory is a useful complement to the real laboratory, but can not completely replace the real laboratory.

articleTitle: Practical Circuit Design to Protect Motor's Phase Failure Operation
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: Three-phase motors are widely used in industrial and agricultural production. However, when phase failure takes place in three-phase motor, it can be a considerable hazard on the motor. But through a simple and practical improvement of protective circuit, the phenomenon of burning motors can be effectively prevented.

articleTitle: A Power Control Strategy for PWM Rectifier under Unbalanced Input Voltage
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: A control strategy of positive and negative sequence controllers for three phase voltage source PWM rectifier based on power-equation principle is proposed aim at eliminating the harmonic of dc output voltage. The strategy calculates the commands of positive and negative sequence currents using the equation principle of instantaneous power, and designs positive and negative sequence controllers to regulate the positive and negative sequence currents separately. By decoupling feed-forward and PI controller, this strategy can achieve good performance. The details of the strategy are given then. The phase of the unbalanced voltage is locked using phase locked loop (PLL). The positive and negative sequence currents are separated and picked up using notch filters, and controlled by decoupling feed-forward and PI controller. The results of the simulation verify the correctness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: A Browser/Server Product Data Management System
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: In this paper, a design of a browser/server product data management (BSPDM) is presented. It is aimed at achieving the goal of e-Manufacturing by providing an effective tool for product database management through the Internet utilizing Java EE technologies. The BSPDM mainly uses Servlets and JSP to handle user inputs and manage and retrieve product data from the database through the JDBC driver, with the server components stored on a web server system called Tomcat. Within this environment, all parties involved in product design and manufacture can access the log-in page with the given URL after a successful identity authorization. Consequently, these users can create, search and/or manipulate the desired engineering data through the enabled BSPDM. The BSPDM developed in this work has been experimentally developed.

articleTitle: Research on Method of Multi-agent Formation Control
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: Multi-robot formation control is the most common form of control of coordinated control. Take the AmigoBot mobile robot which produced by ActivMediaRobotics in USA as a research platform, based on leader-follower model of multi-robot formation method and feedback control strategy. The results show that this model can maintain good V-formation, Simulation and physical experiment results prove that the model is correct and the method is effective, also obtain a good effect of robot formation.

articleTitle: The Investigation on the Sensitivity and Error of Single Bridge
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: By using two kinds of methods the formula on the relative sensitivity of single bridge is given. All factors affecting relative sensitivity are analyzed. The sensitivity of slide bridge and its influence on the measured resistance R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> are discussed. The condition of the minimum relative error is theoretically given. That is the place of the balance point should be chosen according to the ratio of the measured resistance R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> to the internal resistance R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</sub> of the galvanometer in order to get the minimum relative error. Thereby, the theoretical evidence is offered to cut down experimental error by choosing best ratio N.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Mobile Repeater Network Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: With the large-scale application of mobile communication repeater, the operation's management for multitudinous and geographical position disperses is more and more difficult. This system can manage the repeaters in the wireless network via unified control and network management to maintain the right working of the mobile communication repeater. This method can bring enormous convenient to the mobile communication operation companies for long-distance management of repeaters.

articleTitle: Design of Dynamic Electronic Pressure Collection System and Gust Measurement
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: Through the communications of Seater Model 265and Model 267MR-type differential pressure sensors with industrial automation software, a set of electronic pressure acquisition device is established. The dynamic measurement system is composed by the device and PIV to carry on the experiment of wind pressure measurements on buildings in environment wind tunnel under the gust flow. The dynamic system can achieve rapid synchronous pressure measurement on multipoint and automatic recording. Through the dynamic wind pressure measurement on buildings with the flow of sinusoidal wind spectrum, the system is proved to be feasible and reasonable. The system can make a correct response on low-frequency gust and provide the basis and effective means for further study on the dynamic measurement under the gusts.

articleTitle: A Modified Multi-Feature Voiced/Unvoiced Speech Classification Method
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: A modified multi-feature voiced/unvoiced speech classification method is presented. The method is based on statistical analysis of wavelet-based frequency distribution of the average energy, zero-crossing rate, and average energy of short-time segments of the speech signal. The method first classifies the input speech into voiced, unvoiced and uncertain parts by comparing features with predetermined thresholds. Then, the uncertain parts are treated in three conditions and the boundary between voiced and unvoiced speech parts is determined by the average energy feature. The performance of the method has been evaluated using a large speech database. The method is shown to perform well in the cases of both clean and noise-degraded speech.

articleTitle: Application of Improved MAGA to Water Pollution Control System Planning
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: Combining the ability of apperception and counteractive to environment of agent with search method of genetic algorithm, an improved multi-agent genetic algorithm (MAGA) is advanced. It ensures diversity of population and improves local search ability of genetic algorithm by simulating competition, cooperate and self-learning of different agents using neighboring cross operator, aberrance operator and self-learning operator of agent. The algorithm is applied to the optimal planning for the waste treatment system of Urumqi, Xinjiang. Results show an improved performance in finding the global minimum when water quality requirements have been fulfilled. The result demonstrates nicer performance and factual value of improved MAGA.

articleTitle: Constructing Unified Communications, Integrated Network for Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: As the rapid development of science and technology as well as communications technology, there are more and more means of communication. However, the practicability of technology is more viable than an empty concept. The unified communications that have been popular for several years enters into practical stage of improving enterprise efficiency from the concept stage of publicity hype. This paper summarizes the enterprise construction ideas of unified communications and points for attention in construction, and uses a application case to illustrate that the unified communications can bring collaboration convenience for enterprises.

articleTitle: Application of Discrete Particle Swarm Optimaization for Service Selection in Grid
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: Service selection plays a very important role in the grid middleware. Firstly, a service redundancy strategy is adapted and the corresponding target equation is designed for improving the QoS of the whole workflows in the grid. Secondly, considering of determining a optimal service schema virtually belongs to a combinatorial optimization problem, a resolving algorithm based on discrete particle swarm optimization to find a global optimum is proposed, and its encoding methods are given, In which, the suitable parameters in the algorithm are decided through the adjustment experiments. Finally, the results of some experiments show that the algorithm is feasible, and compared with some other algorithms, such as local optimization, greedy algorithm etc, the algorithm in the paper is more effective.

articleTitle: Implementation of JXTA-based P2P System Access from Web Service
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: An heterogeneous distributed system using middleware to finish the visit to each other between P2P and Web Service system is brought forward, and the safety and veracity of visit the service must be ensured. The blue print of middleware is to adding the function of visit Web Service onto the basic function of peer. The middleware provides the service accepting and disposal of request to the Web Service, and then it is responsible for discovering, calling service and returning result. On the basic of two heterogeneous systems visiting each other, in order to find the related service position, the UDDI is added to the middleware. In this way service can be found although simple information is given. In addition, several middleware can group as a peer group, when a common peer joins in the group service which can be provide to enlarge the scale of query and to ensure the safety of system.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis and Suppression of Quadrature Error on Quartz Beam Vibratory Angular Rate Sensor
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: Vibratory beam angular rate sensors are fast becoming the most widely used sensors in many applications. The mathematical modeling on the quadrature error of quartz beam vibratory angular rate sensor was presented in this paper. The effects of quadarture error model to the sensor’s performance were analyzed based on the analysis of work principle and error induced by quadrature. And the correlation detection suppression method to the quadrature error on gyroscope performance was presented. Simulation of the system was also content. The results showed that mean square deviation of output signal was reduced by 54.52???, and the zero drift was suppressed. Hence, the reasonability of the model and the validity of the error suppression algorithm have been proved.

articleTitle: Two Approaches of Implementing Fractional Correlation Operation
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: This paper concerns mainly about two approaches to implement the anamorphic fractional correlation operation. Firstly, the definition of anamorphic fractional correlation is introduced. Secondly, an optical approach of implementing the correlation operation is presented. Lastly, since the optical implementation is somewhat troublesome, we will show how to exploit the anamorphic fractional correlation by computer-generated holography.

articleTitle: The AJAX Application of Public Map Service Website
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: As one of the core technologies of Web2.0, AJAX brings the new power for Web application. This paper analyzes from the AJAX technical system, combining with AJAX technology to develop Guangxi Public Web Map Service, and achieve a good combination of AJAX and WebGIS.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Non-independent Suspension Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: In this paper, six DOF model has been established for non-independent suspension vehicle with Robertson - Widenborg multi-body dynamics method. On this basis, Yaw velocity gain of a heavy vehicle was simulated by Matlab. The simulation results verified the model is reasonable. After further simulation, it indicates the model has theory significant for researching the handling and stability and designing suspension system and the structure layout of this type vehicle.

articleTitle: Digital Controlled High Frequency Switching Mode Power System
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: Design of a dc-dc converter operating at the frequency of MHz is presented. Digital control algorithm is implemented in FPGA and a high resolution PWM pulse generator is built based on the combination of fast clock counter and programmable delay line techniques. The output voltage of this converter is regulated using a phase-shifted PWM scheme. Planar topology for the transformer was adopted and the windings were fabricated by using the printed circuit board. The ability to control the electromagnetic interference of the SMPS was tested and proved to work well.

articleTitle: Application of Piecewise Linear Model to Waterlogging Level Forecasting in Luohu District
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: Water level is an important index for waterlog in the flood control and drainage of city. According to the characteristics of flood control and drainage in Luohu District of Shenzhen city, a water logging level forecasting model corresponding to the rainfall is proposed with piecewise linear model, with the comparison between the model forecasted and the gauging data, the model shows the higher precision and have certain practical value.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Descriptor System with Time Delay
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: In this paper, a design method of model following control system (MFCS) for nonlinear descriptor system with time delay, and disturbances is discussed. Design of the control system is constructed.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Clustering Algorithm Based on the Granular Space Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: Granular Computing (GrC) is a new concept and novel approach to solve the complex problems and provide a method for massive data-mining in the field of artificial intelligence. This paper applied granular space theory to hierarchical clustering method to generate a more efficient two-stage hierarchical clustering algorithm based on granular theory. This Method can reduce the time and memory complexities significantly and make validation very efficient and accurate. so it is very meaningful to the Hierarchical clustering algorithm.

articleTitle: The Valuation of Social Stability in the Industrial Transfer Process of Henan Province Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: It is the age of Economic Globalization at present. The process of industrial transfer brings far-reaching impact on the industry and the industrial structure, and it also affects the society stability of the area. This paper analyzes the impact on society stability of Henan Province which influenced by industrial structure in the few past years, and the stability is valuated by a BP neural network model. An example is studied to certify the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: The Research and Implement of Fatigue System for Online Games
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: It is great harm to physical and mental health of young people addicted to online games for long-term. This paper proposed an fatigue system for online game, which uses online game fingerprint database, hook API and other technical means, and determines and filters games' process in the device drive level. This system provides a simple but powerful online games firewall.

articleTitle: An Application of DSP in the Human-computer Interactive Technology Based on SEMG
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: This paper describes an application of DSP in the Human-computer interactive technology based on SEMG. DSP is used as the core of the system, using AD976 as the A/D converter. Using DSP processes the collected SEMG signal and feature extraction. Adopting some simple and easy method to classify the feature values, converted the different actions to the corresponding control commands, then send the commands to the robot, achieved the human-computer interactive technology based on SEMG. The practice has proved that this program has high feasibility and high application value.

articleTitle: Application and Future Development of Land Use Change Detection Based on Remote Sensing Technology in China
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: This paper summarizes the National Land Use Change Detection Program, the present situation in remote sensing techniques and applications for land management in China. Special attention is given to the recent results that have been achieved in remote sensing applications, such as land use database updating, verification of land use planning, etc. The paper also touches upon the future trends of developing remote sensing in China.

articleTitle: Influences of Effective Width of Photo-electric Sensor on Acceleration Measurement
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: Starting from experiments, this paper revealed influencing factors of effective width of photo-electric sensors, analyzed some reasons why effective width gave rise to acceleration measurement errors, and raised several improvement methods.

articleTitle: Design of MFCS for Chemical Engineering System in Discrete Time
publicationTitle: 2010 Asia-Pacific Conference on Power Electronics and Design
abstract: Model following control system (MFCS) can give general output signals following to desired ones. In this paper, a method of nonlinear MFCS will be extend to nonlinear chemical engineering systems of discrete time. Nonlinear systems which are dealt in this paper have the property of norm constraint ||f(x(k))|| ≤ α + β||x(k)||<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">γ</sup>, where α ≥ 0, β ≥ 0, 0 ≤ γ <; 1. In this case, a new criterion is proposed to ensure that internal states are stable.
